artifact_type: 45-run entropy factorial (5 seeds x 3 windows x 3 scenarios)
purpose: Anchor Paper 4 Table 6 to a verifiable snapshot within the paper4-esorics reproducibility kit. The upstream generative pipeline (synthetic scenario generation, RDF ingestion via Fuseki, sliding-window entropy computation) is NOT re-implemented here; it remains in the companion repository referenced below.

imported_files.description: Curated 45-run summary: (scenario, config, W, stride, entropy_metric) -> (t_detect, delay, pre-event FPs, peak |Delta H|). Backs Paper 4 Table 6.
Publication-ready longtable of the same 45-run summary. Rendered as Table 6 in paper/main_v4.tex.

import.method: Static snapshot import via raw.githubusercontent.com. No modification of file contents; SHA-256 pinned above.
import.rationale: The upstream pipeline is Docker/Fuseki-based and would add heavy build dependencies to paper4-esorics that are unrelated to the ESORICS submission's core reproducibility scope (real CIC-IDS2017 rerun + SPARQL scaling). Importing the two artefacts as a verified snapshot preserves the paper's claim about the 45-run factorial while keeping paper4-esorics lean. The upstream pipeline remains fully accessible and executable from the companion repository for readers who wish to regenerate the CSV from scratch.

paper_references.table_in_paper: Table 6 (Results-ready summary of the entropy-based sensitivity analysis)
